title: On the Cultural Gap in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models using the C3 benchmark, which consists of challenging prompts featuring Chinese cultural elements, and scoring the generated images via human evaluation on criteria such as cultural appropriateness, cross-cultural object presence, and semantic consistency.

Prompting models to identify failures in accounting for linguistic inaccuracies or nuances related to Chinese script, and evaluating the translation quality of cross-cultural image captions using multi-modal alignment metrics and human judgments.
